blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of all five current views and six pose renders confirms V29 bilateral thigh-surface placement materially moves the front overskirt across the upper thighs in sit and crouch, addressing the V28 side-placement failure. It still does not form continuous controlled lap coverage: shorts remain exposed below/through the front opening, with separate pointed panels and raw angular edges around the seated thighs. This is a placement improvement, not accepted pose coverage.

Direct front, back, left, right, three-quarter, neutral, arms-up, arm-cross, sit, crouch, and prone inspection still shows coarse triangular surface faceting, uneven hem lines, and layered or protruding panel corners. The current geometry transfer does not smooth the skirt silhouette or produce clean sewn transitions.
The current back render still does not present a distinct, readable rear adjustment tab or buckle.
Authored UV mapping remains missing. The automatic prototype unwrap is not authored UV evidence, and the inspected images are not a UV layout.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
